titulo.alumno: Reading a rule or warning with «ものではない»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

palabras.significado: to assume; to jump to conclusions

piezas.titulo: «ものではない» expresses a rule, warning or general judgment; the tone can be admonishing.
texto: It's not simply a polite piece of advice, nor a universal legal prohibition. Pay attention to who is speaking and which rule is referred to.
個人 情報 を 確認 せず に、他人 へ 転送 する もの では ありません。 (Personal data shouldn't be forwarded to another person without checking it first.)
一度 の 失敗 だけ で、能力 が ない と 決めつける もの では ありません。 (One shouldn't conclude that someone lacks ability because of a single mistake.)
